title: Split the brother_printer cups_queue test modules under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring test_cups_queue.py (458 lines) and test_cups_queue_part2.py (278 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by partitioning them along the class boundaries the source split already established, without losing or weakening a single test.
acceptance_criteria: All six cups_queue test modules are at most 250 lines.
The brother_printer suite still reports exactly 402 passing tests -- the same count as before the split, proving no test was dropped or silently skipped.
The package keeps 100% branch coverage of the brother_printer source modules.
No MOD constant changes: every name these tests patch already lives in the module the file names, so the split is a pure partition of test classes.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened; whole test classes move verbatim and only the import blocks are adjusted to what each file actually uses.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Touching the brother_printer source, which is already under the cap.
Splitting the remaining over-cap test modules (test_cups_service.py, test_display.py, test_usb_query.py and the consumables pair), which are separate commits.
Introducing a shared conftest.py: these classes need no shared fixture builders, and an unnecessary one would push jscpd toward its duplication threshold.
verifier: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/brother_printer/tests -q (expects exactly 402 passed), plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files, plus bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all for the cap.
